text: Risk management is the process of identifying, assessing and controlling threats to a project or business. The first step is identifying risks, which means looking carefully at what could go wrong and how likely it is. Once risks are clear, mitigation strategies can reduce their impact, for example by improving safety or training staff. It is also wise to prepare contingency plans, so you know what to do if a problem happens despite your efforts. Finally, monitoring is essential because risks change over time. Regular reviews help you spot new dangers early and adjust your plans. Good risk management does not remove all uncertainty, but it helps you respond calmly and protect your goals.
